identity_reason: a layout primitive only places other components and has no look of its own to derive
concept: Container holds a page of units to a width the eye can scan, with a margin from the page edge that grows with the screen.

root.why: The page margin and centred width keep units in the same place at every visit.

s-sm.why: The narrowest page width holds one column of units for a phone held in one hand.

s-md.why: The tablet width holds two units side by side without stretching either face.

s-lg.why: The laptop width holds a room of three units in a row at a glance.

s-xl.why: The wide width holds four units in a row before the line becomes too long to scan.

s-2xl.why: The widest page stops growing here, so units never drift far apart on large screens.
